description: Figure 7 illustrates the relationship between the number of training samples and the Micro F1 score for KnowPrompt. The x-axis is labeled “Relation Category” and displays categories as text, with no defined scale or units. The y-axis is labeled “Micro F1 (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.22, with tick labels at intervals of 0.02. There are three lines displayed: a solid blue line representing “w/o DPO obs & w/o div-hint”, a solid orange line representing “w/o DPO obs”, and a dashed green line representing “Average of w/o DPO obs & w/o div-hint”. The blue line begins at approximately 0.04 for the first relation category and increases to approximately 0.18 for the last relation category. The orange line starts at approximately 0.05 for the first relation category and rises to approximately 0.20 for the last relation category. The green line begins at approximately 0.045 for the first relation category and increases to approximately 0.19 for the last relation category.
